name: Brine Ward
pitch: Harbor sentry who braces the line.
lore: Raised on rift-tide docks, Brine Ward makes shields from salt and oath.

name: Ember Pike
lore: Forge apprentices temper spears in living coal vents along the Rift rim.

name: Reed Chorus
lore: Marsh cantors braid healing tones through hollow reeds.

name: Night Pin
lore: Night Pin learned to end fights before lanterns are lit.

name: Spark Novice
lore: First-year Rift scholars still scorch their own cuffs.

name: Slate Clerk
lore: Orders are written once, then the battlefield obeys or breaks.

name: Dust Skipper
lore: Skips so lightly the sand forgets footprints.

name: Coil Apprentice
lore: Tiny rift coils answer when called politely.

name: Iron Pail
lore: If it fits in a pail, Iron Pail will defend it.

name: Yellow Fuse
lore: Fuse burns short. So do patience and enemies.

name: Balm Twin
lore: Two heartbeats, one cleanse kit.

name: Cinder Scout
lore: Maps forge roads before the smoke settles.

name: Mist Suture
pitch: Field medic weaving fog into seals.
lore: Mist Suture binds wounds with condensed Aetherium vapor.

name: Glass Runner
pitch: Courier who sprints rift glass roads.
lore: Speed is survival when the road can cut you.

name: Bulwark Lynn
lore: Lynn never rushes. The wall arrives when needed.

name: Hex Latch
lore: Latch runes refuse to let go of ankles or plans.

name: Veil Knife
lore: If you see the veil, the cut already happened.

name: Anvil Choir
lore: Hammers sing until steel answers.

name: Map Wick
lore: Wrong routes go up in wick-smoke.

name: Echo Pupil
lore: Pupils learn by copying the battlefield badly, then better.

name: Gale Stitch
lore: Stitches torn banners and torn skin with the same thread.

name: Rim Raider
lore: Raids the rim, then vanishes into updrafts.

name: Kairo Ren
lore: Kairo Ren maps enemy habits like constellations, then erases the bright stars first.

name: Lyra Stormveil
pitch: Storm mage who shifts the field.
lore: Lyra threads lightning through formation gaps until armies rearrange themselves.

name: Bastion Ore
lore: Ore that chose a creed and a posture.

name: Sable Flute
lore: Fear leaves when the sable melody arrives.

name: Crimson Ledger
lore: Every wound is an invoice. Collection is inevitable.

name: Quill Raze
lore: Signatures burn hotter than seals.

name: Hop Mirage
lore: You swing where they were. They are already gone.

name: Loom Wisp
lore: Wisps hold swords until the loom says drop.

name: Astra Veyron
lore: Astra Veyron folds star mass into a tower shield that refuses to fall.

name: Quill Tactician
lore: Ink from rift-squid records futures that never quite happen.

name: Obsidian Mire
lore: Mire does not splash. It claims.

name: Gilded Saw
lore: Beauty is a blade if the angle is honest.

name: Haven Bell
lore: One peal, and broken ranks remember they are an army.

name: Zephyr Fang
pitch: Skirmisher tooth of the high wind.
lore: Fang rides the gale until armor forgets where front is.

name: Mirror Host
lore: The Mirror Host invites echoes to fight in borrowed silhouettes.

name: Iron Psalm
lore: Psalm plates hum until siege engines reconsider.

name: Violet Auditor
lore: If the timeline is crooked, Violet stamps it void.

name: Thorn Cantor
lore: Notes sprout thorns. Thorns sprout consequences.

name: Black Relay
lore: Delivery confirmed means someone stopped answering.

name: Sol Archon
pitch: Legendary solar spear of the Vanguard.
lore: When the Rift dimmed, Sol Archon lit a spear from a dying star and kept walking.

name: Mare Absolver
lore: Absolution arrives as a tide that refuses to leave anyone drowned.

name: Crown of Cinders
lore: A crown that cuts, because crowns should earn their weight.

name: Silent Congress
lore: Motions pass without voices. Outcomes still shout.

name: Null Seraph
lore: Null Seraph does not roar. Space simply forgets what stood there.

name: Aurora Lattice
lore: Lattices of dawn rewrite where storms are allowed to land.

name: Warden Infinite
lore: The gate does not close. It simply chooses who passes.

name: Aether Sovereign
pitch: Supreme apex of Battle Card Supreme.
lore: A throne of living Rift law. Still counterable. Never a free win.

name: First Fracture
pitch: Supreme origin wound given a name.
lore: The first crack in reality learned manners, then war.
